commercialPurpose: Support rich long-form content pages when the buyer needs full-width storytelling without a sidebar.
purposeLayer: The full-width article state makes complex editorial content feel immersive and readable.
anatomyLayer: Centered article title/meta, wide hero image, drop cap intro, quote pullout, inline images, lists, gallery grid, video embed, author block, related posts, comments, and reply form.
hierarchyLayer: Title and hero image first, article body second, media/gallery modules third, discussion form last.
gridRhythmLayer: Single centered content column with variable-width media blocks and long vertical breathing room.
densityLimitLayer: Use one story, 2-5 inline media modules, 0-1 gallery, 0-1 video, and comments only after content closure.
originalityLayer: Learn full-width editorial state; transform media sequencing, quote style, list treatment, and discussion modules.
usageRuleLayer: Use for feature articles, portfolio stories, case studies, documentation essays, or resource-detail pages.
layoutGesture: full-width editorial article with media-state stack
sectionSilhouette: single central reading column with wide media moments
compositionTension: long text rhythm broken by wide image, gallery, and video modules
focalPath: title to hero image to body to media stack to comments
negativeSpaceShape: tall white reading runway around centered content
depthLayering: flat article surface with embedded media cards and form blocks
moduleScaleVariation: wide media blocks mixed with narrow text paragraphs and small related cards
breakoutBehavior: media can widen beyond paragraph width while staying centered
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact Pallas article assets, pull quote, gold separators, or comment form styling.

hyperAccuracyReceipt.reviewNotes: Checkpoint 002 is visually inspected learning evidence; keep incoming until exact hyper-accuracy review and dedupe rationale pass.
hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy the exact Pallas editorial visuals, startup hero background, coral/teal color identity, photo assets, sidebar widget order, or footer treatment.
